name: netintel
description: Pay-per-call network, domain, web and inference lookups for agents — DNS, SSL, WHOIS, IP reputation, email verification, web fetch & search, OpenAI-compatible gateway, embeddings, market data — paid per call in USDC over x402. No API keys.

evm_private_key.title: Agent wallet private key (Base)
evm_private_key.description: Private key (0x…) of a wallet holding USDC on Base mainnet. Every tool call pays its listed price from this wallet via x402; nothing else is charged. Use a dedicated agent wallet funded with a few dollars, never your main wallet. Stored in secure storage.
